001-discovering-architecture-online.caption:
Discovering architecture online got dumbed down. So we built this. 🧱

We're a few architects who kept hitting the same wall: Pinterest is beautiful but nameless, and most sites need you to know a building before you can find it.

Discover Architecture is one big wall of 1,600 buildings you wander instead of search.
→ Shuffle it, or hit Surprise me
→ Open any building for photos, key features and links to drawings and articles
→ Filter by idea, type, movement, region and era

Free. No sign-up. Every photo credited. Link in bio.

Which building should we add next? Tell us below 👇
Send this to someone who loves buildings.

004-detail-fallingwater.caption:
They asked for a view of the waterfall. Frank Lloyd Wright built the house on top of it.

Fallingwater (1939): concrete terraces cantilevered over the falls, so the building and the stream become one thing.

006-architect-oscar-niemeyer.caption:
Oscar Niemeyer didn't do straight lines.

A cathedral of curved concrete ribs, a wavy tower with 1,000+ homes, a museum that floats over the bay like a saucer. He built for over 70 years.

All 33 of his buildings → link in bio
Curves or right angles — which side are you on?
